metadata.description: Bounded constant-volume fuel partner, dilution, lean, and frozen-EGR sensitivity screen.
metadata.egr_scope: single-pass frozen synthetic Beta-2.3-like exhaust vector at 0, 20, 40%; no repeated-cycle feedback claim.
metadata.ignition_criterion: repository mechanism_gate.constant_volume_ignition: accepted-step maximum dP/dt; delay qualified only after +400 K and integration continued to +1000 K

mechanisms.caveat: 39-species Zhao reduction; parent retention is not experimental validation.
mechanisms.name: zhao_sk39

mechanisms.caveat: Distributed source activates the 1-atm DME decomposition fit; 40-bar selection is open.
mechanisms.name: zhao_full

mechanisms.caveat: Independent LLNL DME lineage; this blend screen is not direct validation.
mechanisms.name: llnl79

mechanisms.caveat: Burke package loads and species are compatible, but point-level direct validation remains blocked.
mechanisms.name: burke

metadata.partner_screen_scope: CH4, H2, CO, C2H6, C2H4 at 15/85, 25/75, 40/60, and 60/40 DME/partner on Zhao sk39; core CH4, CO and pure-DME references plus full DME/CO dilution table cross-checked on every declared mechanism.
metadata.sign_convention: ordinary ignition has S < 0; positive S is NTC-like shape only, not self-stabilization.
